I couldn't write these notes. My first attempt to fetch the source pages hit the tool's usage limit, my second attempt was blocked, and no tool calls are left for this turn. So I didn't read any of the pages, not even Enduring Word, Bible Hub (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit), Precept Austin, Wesley's notes on StudyLight or the NET Bible notes.

You asked me to report only what the pages actually say, with a URL for each point. Writing notes now would mean filling them in from memory and giving links I haven't read, so I haven't written any.

**What to do next:** ask again in a new message and I'll run the research then. These are the pages I planned to read first:

1. Enduring Word (David Guzik) on Ecclesiastes 6: https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/ecclesiastes-6/
2. Precept Austin on Ecclesiastes 6: https://www.preceptaustin.org/ecclesiastes-6-commentary
3. Ellicott on Bible Hub: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/ecclesiastes/6.htm
4. Gill on Bible Hub: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/ecclesiastes/6.htm
5. Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/ecclesiastes/6.htm
6. Wesley's Explanatory Notes on StudyLight, for the Methodist view
7. NET Bible notes, for modern scholarship: https://netbible.org/bible/Ecclesiastes+6
8. Searches on New Advent (Church Fathers), OCA, Ligonier, Desiring God, Got Questions and Bible Odyssey for different traditions' readings. I'd look especially at the stillborn child (vv. 3–5), "what happens to a man is foreknown" (v. 10), and verses 7–9 on desire and wealth.

To get through more of the list next time, I'll fetch the pages one or two at a time instead of all at once.
